title: Cache monthly summaries
pr_description: monthly_summary is the hottest query in the dashboard, so cache its result per (user, month). Includes a test showing the cache returns consistent results.

defects.description: Nothing ever invalidates the cache. expenses.add_expense and delete_expense (outside this diff) mutate the underlying rows, so after any new expense the dashboard, budget_status and over-budget flags serve stale totals for the rest of the process lifetime.
The module-global cache grows without bound (every user x month ever queried) and is shared across Database instances, so tests or multi-tenant embedders leak entries between unrelated databases.

The added test calls monthly_summary twice with no writes in between and asserts the results are equal — that can never fail and specifically avoids the write-then-read sequence that exposes the stale cache.
